verdict.rationale: Adyen's Issuing docs describe core operations as API calls: creating cards as paymentInstrument resources, updating cards via /paymentInstruments/{id}, raising disputes through the Raise disputes API, and receiving relayed-authorisation and other webhooks. An llms.txt index is also published. Some setup still runs through the Customer Area UI, such as configuring relayed authorisation and the pilot zip upload for disputes, and probes at the common OpenAPI paths returned 404. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec evidence, API-only configuration of relayed authorisation and dispute evidence upload, documented API authentication/reference details, independent hands-on corroboration.
